type: versioned development snapshot; coding-agent assignments are explicit, human staffing is not implied

status_definitions.conditional: Select only if preceding observations support the change.
status_definitions.blocked_human: Requires willing real participants; no agent roleplay substitute.
status_definitions.active: Assigned and in progress; not completed.
status_definitions.done: Acceptance criteria met with linked evidence.
status_definitions.not_selected: Explicitly closed by a recorded design decision.

gates.requirement: Vivid’s two-story plan is approved and implemented. Small Hours and Bell retain their proposed/conditional plans; their implementation has not started in this iteration.

Keep six distinct titles and at least four broad families per lane. Vivid has six core-play titles across five families, with three declared units completed and three endpoint gaps. Keep partials and original native gaps explicit; no lane is declared fully studied.
Observe actual people using the per-game protocol; automated checks and emotional agent prose are not human evidence.

tasks.title: Publish the incoming-record delta and provenance ledger
tasks.deliverable: A lane intake note linked to the immutable source, with one row per M1–M6 assignment and an explicit TEAM-01 lane-intake disposition.
acceptance_criteria: Record that 875230b adds six documentation/evidence files and changes no gameplay or tests relative to 822366ad.
Classify M1 as lobby-only, M2 as menu-only/tooling-blocked with zero gameplay, and M3–M6 as source-only/unplayed in this reviewed package.
Record that the Make it Meme note and three PNGs are byte-identical to the older Vivid package; preserve October 13 session and October 15 reshoot dates.
Flag the M1 index/raw-record wording discrepancy and the unsupported-in-this-package Townscaper cross-branch reference for reconciliation.
Close only the Small Hours incoming-record intake when incorporated; keep competitor coverage and human validation open.

tasks.owner_role: Small Hours research lead + access coordinator
tasks.title: Make the remaining M3–M6 coverage executable
tasks.deliverable: A versioned access/edition ledger and future session briefs for Hanabi, GeoGuessr, Townscaper and Florence; source recovery for any claimed shared Townscaper session.
acceptance_criteria: For Hanabi, document legitimate accounts, separate views, same-IP conditions and a real partner; for GeoGuessr, identify the exact consumer mode, eligible host and agreed round boundary.
For Townscaper and Florence, record existing license/device availability or keep the rows blocked; do not treat a browser demo as the selected full desktop edition.
Retrieve and reconcile the claimed Townscaper record before reuse: exact edition, actor, date, creation/revision/finish/save boundary and original evidence; shared M5/V5 evidence counts as one title.
Write each future journey target from the matrix, including failure/recovery when encountered, ending or bounded unit, exit and actual repeat; distinguish planned from observed stages.

Any reserve promotion includes the lost question and recalculated six-title/four-family rules, at least two outside narrative/deduction, no more than two per family and at most one occasion comparator.
Do not purchase, create accounts or launch a competitor while preparing this plan; unavailable access remains an explicit gap.

tasks.owner_role: Human research facilitator + Small Hours researcher
tasks.title: Complete staged competitor journeys, starting with M1/M2
tasks.deliverable: An M1/M2 human comparison milestone, followed by scoped M3–M6 studies as access permits, each with a journey, system observations and an art board.
acceptance_criteria: Use real willing participants; disclose observer assistance and prior knowledge. An agent controlling both sides does not satisfy the social question.
M1 records join, authoring, reveal/judgment, three agreed rounds and the actual repeat/leave decision; distinguish authorship, recognition, surprise and scoring.
M2 uses a keyboard capable of WASD, arrows and held inputs; records role division, introduction, a coordination-level completion, natural recovery if encountered and continue/leave.

After SH-02 resolves access, M3 targets a complete Hanabi game/debrief; M4 an agreed private location session/recalled detail; M5 a creation/revision/finish/save cycle in the selected edition; M6 the full story/ending and recalled interaction. Unreached targets stay explicitly partial or blocked.
Record active play, setup and notes separately; preserve the October 20 tool limitation as that session’s limitation, not a general game defect.
Store exact stop points and capture provenance; incomplete sessions retain their partial status and do not satisfy the full-journey gate.

tasks.title: Settle the unchanged-build six-pair protocol
tasks.deliverable: A short neutral facilitator script, observation sheet and predeclared decision rules for the current build.
acceptance_criteria: Pin 875230b as the reviewed source and state that its game files match 822366ad; log the actual tested build if the study later uses another export.
Observe entry, private choice/prediction, handoff, reveal, actual offscreen activity, optional writing, save/leave and voluntary repeat without explaining the intended payoff.
Record both people’s contributions, assistance, stopping, device/browser, time to reveal and voluntary comments; do not solicit or collect keepsakes by default.
Predeclare the formative gates: 5/6 pairs reach reveal unaided, 4/6 show both contributing and 3/6 voluntarily save or replay; these are diagnostic thresholds, not population or retention estimates.
Give the unchanged build first. Record prediction and writing friction qualitatively; do not mix an unimplemented no-prediction variant into the baseline.
A person may stop without explanation; seated/imaginary participation and blank writing stay valid.

tasks.title: Observe six willing pairs on the unchanged build
tasks.deliverable: Six de-identified pair observations, an actual-sample summary and the three gate counts.
acceptance_criteria: Record recruitment context and willingness; include friends/partners where feasible without treating six pairs as representative.
Observe rather than enact the shared activity; separately record A and B contributions and any one-person carrying of the task.
Do not prompt saving or replay; distinguish choosing the interface’s replay button from a later voluntary return.
Report assistance, exits, missing data and contrary cases. If fewer than six pairs attend, state the actual denominator and leave six-pair thresholds unevaluated.
Keep participant statements separate from observer interpretation and agent-generated examples.

tasks.title: Choose one response to the baseline, including no change or stop
tasks.deliverable: A brief observation → problem → hypothesis → falsifier decision, with explicit disposition of SH-07/08/09.
acceptance_criteria: Apply all three baseline gates and examine qualitative exceptions before selecting a change.
Select at most one bounded experiment: prediction/handoff friction, complementary activity prompts, or the earned keepsake ending; document why the others are not selected.
If both people do not want the activity, consider revising the proposition or stopping before polishing export.
Identify the expected changed behavior, a result that would reject the hypothesis, and remaining rival explanations.
Keep six-competitor validation open even if the internal pilot is encouraging; an internal result does not replace required competitor journeys.

tasks.title: If selected, address observed prediction or handoff friction
tasks.deliverable: One bounded future interaction variant and a transition/copy specification tied to the baseline issue.
acceptance_criteria: Activate only if SH-06 selects this hypothesis; otherwise record a not-selected disposition.
If prediction becomes optional, a skipped prediction is represented explicitly and the reveal never invents a guess or matching outcome.
If handoff is the issue, identify the exact confusing step before reducing or rewriting controls; the twelve-activation count alone is not evidence of human friction.
Preserve informed pair participation, solo-rehearsal labels, private versus joint curtains, keyboard/touch equivalence and End & forget.
Deliver only this selected flow change on the game’s own future implementation workstream after the decision; no change is made by this planning task.

tasks.title: If selected, make each person’s contribution to the activity clearer
tasks.deliverable: One revised scene-prompt set with a before/after role map and a falsifiable contribution hypothesis.
acceptance_criteria: Activate only if SH-06 identifies weak or one-sided participation; otherwise record a not-selected disposition.
Show the fixed scene activity, A’s selected role prompt and B’s selected role prompt separately so the causal change is inspectable.
Preserve stable scene/choice IDs, three choices per current scene, imaginary/seated alternatives and permission to alter or leave the activity.
Do not demand personal disclosure, add a relationship score or use claims of togetherness as instructions to participants.
Test the proposed wording against the observed confusion; no extra scene is part of this experiment.

tasks.title: If selected, make the ending recognizably belong to both people
tasks.deliverable: A compact ending storyboard and, only when chosen, one bounded keepsake variant aligned with the joint-authorship hypothesis.
acceptance_criteria: Activate only when the activity works but the baseline ending does not; otherwise record a not-selected disposition.
Trace the signature action → contribution → artifact; current SVG content is two optional written lines plus scene title/stamp, not a direct visualization of earlier choices.
Keep each person’s contribution legible in the card and export, including one or two blank contributions; any edit-before-save step preserves mutual agreement.
Use the existing table/window/paper visual language and legible text; do not add unrelated decoration, captured photos or asset pipelines.
Compare recognition of this particular moment, not a generic preference for prettier art; altered exports retain escaping and readable long text.

tasks.title: Check comfortable participation on real devices
tasks.deliverable: A dated device/accessibility matrix with actual observations and unresolved gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Use a physical iPhone/Safari and Android/Chrome where available; record models, OS/browser, virtual keyboard, background/resume, reload, SVG saving and browser history.
Inspect keyboard focus and order, visible labels, zoom/reflow, contrast and reduced motion; record assistive-technology checks actually performed.
Verify a seated/imaginary route and comfortable stop/change-scene/blank-writing route with willing people; do not claim universal accessibility from technical checks.
Exercise the actual hosted embed only when that distribution path is available; the previous synthetic iframe check is not an itch.io device test.
Log severity and reproduction for any barrier; a serious participation or privacy-confusion issue takes priority over expanding scenes.

tasks.title: Integrate only the selected experiment with explicit state ownership
tasks.deliverable: A narrow future implementation branch/patch, transition contract and source manifest for the selected change.
acceptance_criteria: Begin only after SH-06 and the selected SH-07/08/09 specification; document the other cards’ not-selected disposition.
Keep content in content.js, rules/export in state.js, event transitions in game.js and rendering in views.js/CSS; one owner resolves shared transitions.
Preserve ephemeral session behavior, hidden-stage DOM filtering, escaped user strings, optional timer behavior, restart and reset contracts.
Record the exact baseline and variant commits and the smallest changed file set; no storage, backend, accounts or remote-play architecture is introduced.
If SH-06 selects no change or stop, deliver a no-build disposition instead of creating a patch.

tasks.title: Verify the selected variant and preserve evidence boundaries
tasks.deliverable: A verification report linked to the exact reviewed source, or a documented reuse of the unchanged baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Run the existing 33 behavioral assertions only against a changed build or another justified verification target; explain changed expectations rather than preserving a stale assertion count.
Cover affected keyboard/touch controls, private/joint DOM content, all impacted scenes, blank/long/markup text, SVG parsing, timer, replay, cancel/end and reload paths.
Label synthetic Chromium, emulated phone, real-device and human observations separately; passing automation is not evidence of fun or pair authorship.
For unchanged/no-build outcomes, cite the October 20 verification at 822366ad and the no-game-file delta; do not fabricate a new run timestamp.
Resolve any blocker before the follow-up study, and record exact evidence paths and remaining limitations.

tasks.title: Prepare a truthful browser invitation and hosting checklist
tasks.deliverable: A reviewable invitation, short platform-fit brief and package checklist for a direct link/itch.io browser context.
acceptance_criteria: Explain the actual occasion: two willing people, one screen, private choices, a shared activity and an optional keepsake; describe five minutes as a design target until observed timings support it.
Keep a portal such as CrazyGames as a separate acquisition hypothesis with requirements still to verify; do not claim acceptance or audience demand.
Specify relative static assets, full play/ package, embed sizing, keyboard/touch access and download behavior; link actual host checks when later performed.
State that the active session clears on reload/leave and a downloaded file remains with the player; curtains are visual courtesy rather than device security.
Do not claim market uniqueness, memory improvement, relationship benefit, human-tested accessibility or retention; no upload, publication or campaign is part of this card.

tasks.title: If a variant exists, compare its targeted behavior with the baseline
tasks.deliverable: A predeclared comparison protocol, actual session observations and a narrow advance/revise/stop recommendation.
acceptance_criteria: Begin only after a selected variant passes SH-12; if there is no variant, record that disposition and use SH-05/06 rather than manufacturing a comparison.
Use fresh pairs or a declared counterbalanced order; state the actual sample, prior exposure, learning effects and missing data.
Choose the target metric/observation before sessions: prediction friction, balanced contribution, or recognizable ending; avoid changing multiple levers.
Record contrary evidence, comfort leaving and voluntary keep/replay; do not interpret a small formative comparison as a causal population estimate.
If later recall/return is studied, obtain an agreed follow-up and report actual attendance; agent replay never fills that gap.

tasks.owner_role: Game designer + research lead + art reviewer
tasks.title: Write the three-question decision brief with unresolved evidence visible
tasks.deliverable: A separate Small Hours brief comparing complete player stories and deciding advance, revise, further study or stop.
acceptance_criteria: Answer why someone might choose this break, how it differs in the chosen browser context, and which signature action → consequence → payoff is worth testing.
Use observed M1/M2 contrasts plus M3–M6 only to their recorded scope; six titles/four families remain an unmet gate until actual qualifying studies exist.
Offer two or three concise alternative stories with a strongest precedent, production cost, likely failure and rejecting observation, rather than a list of desired features.
Include baseline and any follow-up human results, contrary evidence, access/device limits and exact source links; separate human statements from design hypotheses.
A no-change/stop outcome may close the experiment without building a variant; a further-study outcome leaves research tasks visibly open.

tasks.title: Assign accountable owners and protect the pilot-first sequence
tasks.deliverable: A role-to-person ownership map, dependency review and acceptance/evidence handoff convention.
acceptance_criteria: Name one accountable research owner, human facilitator, designer, content/visual owners, transition integrator, QA reviewer and distribution owner; roles may be combined without inflating sample size.
Confirm that all cards are proposed, conditional or blocked_human and no future feature has completion evidence yet.
Do not assign parallel edits to shared transition files; preserve the game branch/worktree ownership contract and source/evidence pinning.
For each conditional card, record selection or not-selected/no-build disposition after the decision; a disposition is not an implemented feature.
Track participant/device/access needs separately from person-hours; share only de-identified observations and agreed artifacts with the integration reviewer.

tasks.title: Stage one immutable candidate on master
tasks.deliverable: A versioned release-candidates/small-hours/<version>/ package on master, built from the owning game branch.
acceptance_criteria: Record the exact source SHA, version, player-facing notes, build inventory and hash; include a portable build/index.html and only intended files.
Use the release-candidate template and staging validator. Preserve the predeclared human-session protocol before recruiting; staging may contain pending evidence and is not an official release.
Keep the previous candidate and source branch recoverable, push master without force, and verify its remote SHA. Do not merge the whole game branch into master or main.

tasks.title: Review the exact candidate against the human release gate
tasks.deliverable: A complete human-playtest.json and linked anonymized records for the exact packaged build, with a recorded approve/revise/stop decision.
acceptance_criteria: Six predeclared pairs (12 distinct people): at least 5/6 reach the reveal unaided, 4/6 pairs both contribute, and 3/6 voluntarily save or replay. Record the actual choice and both contributions, including failures and assistance.

Include every one of the six predeclared sessions, distinct pseudonymous participant IDs, raw observations and assistance. An incomplete, abandoned or assisted attempt cannot be silently replaced or counted as unaided success.

Zero unresolved critical bugs; manually check actual browser entry, core journey, failure/retry, keyboard, and one physical mobile/touch device. Record measured duration and issues rather than inferring results from automated checks.

An independent human reviewer inspects the evidence and signs the build-specific approval. Existing pilot sessions may be reused only if the protocol was predeclared, participants and required outcomes are recorded, and the artifact hash matches exactly; changed builds need revalidation.
Run full candidate validation. A failed gate stays on master; agent sessions and synthetic test fixtures cannot satisfy human evidence.

tasks.title: Promote only the approved game version to main
tasks.deliverable: A reviewed official release package, registry entry, GitHub version and release-note links, plus a verified playable Pages URL.
acceptance_criteria: Copy only the approved candidate package into releases/<game>/<version>/ on main. Pin its immutable ancestor commit on master; preserve all previous official versions and registry entries.
Open a main promotion PR with human approval and gate results. Required owner review and release-gate must pass; do not auto-merge or include unrelated candidates.

After the human-approved merge, verify automated GitHub release publication, tag target, notes, registry links and the deployed Pages build. A push or draft link alone is not a verified official delivery.
If publication fails, preserve the approved artifact, report the actual failure and rerun only the failed publication step. Never rewrite a released version; publish corrections under a new version.

tasks.title: Record the approved two-story direction and product hypotheses
tasks.deliverable: An accepted, evidence-bounded decision for the Vivid anthology and Iona remembered/neutral comparison.
acceptance_criteria: State why someone might play, why choose this browser experience, and which action/consequence may distinguish it; record falsifiers rather than market-uniqueness claims.
Implement the approved multi-day scope: tactile 3D frame plus painted portrait, a full Iona story and a short object-led Mara story.
Keep the six-competitor research ledger and all human outcomes open; approval to implement is not proof of audience preference.
Keep the technical game ID keepers-frame and one Vivid branch; use explicit story packs rather than creating extra game lanes.
tasks.completion_note: User-approved direction recorded and implemented; research hypotheses remain unvalidated.

tasks.title: Finish missing competitor endpoints after six-title reconciliation
tasks.deliverable: Preserve the six-title journey ledger and qualified synthesis, then add the missing Six Cats ending, WBWWB full cycle and ADOFAI tutorial completion as new dated sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Use Sort the Court! Poki edition, Six Cats Under HTML5, Adventures With Anxiety, We Become What We Behold, Townscaper browser demo and A Dance of Fire and Ice browser demo.
Record entry, goals, inputs, feedback, mistakes, recovery, observed stopping point and re-entry where actually reached; partial or blocked access is not completion.
Keep Event[0], TOEM, full native Townscaper and Rhythm Doctor as unplayed native gaps. Do not pool older editions, screenshots, criticism or agent interpretation into fresh play results.
Retain at least four broad families and two titles outside narrative/deduction. Reconcile the complete records before updating comparative counts or conclusions.

Complete Six Cats rescue/post-ending restart, WBWWB cycle/post-completion re-entry and ADOFAI tutorial with heard audio and reliable calibration. Preserve partials and disclose assistance; do not pool separate runs as completion.
tasks.completion_note: Six core-play titles and five families are documented; three declared units completed and three remain partial. The synthesis answers all three product questions as hypotheses. Endpoint follow-ups remain open.

tasks.title: Implement the rescue, recollection and remembered return contract
tasks.deliverable: Pure story transitions for first rescue, The Worn Notch, both Iona return placements and the neutral routine.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve evidence-gated ferry signalling, visible clues, safe wrong-answer retries and no countdown.
After rescue, brace the shade and fit a wedge in an explicitly earlier watch; each accepted action changes the scene before returning to the present.
Private history offers a folded letter in the recess; public history offers an approved dedication on the harbour-facing edge. Completed saves open the return without restarting rescue.
Neutral profile uses the same rescue/recollection and a comparable cloth placement without prior-choice reference; invalid or repeated placement cannot complete a wrong state.
tasks.completion_note: Rules and state scenarios implemented; human understanding is not yet measured.

tasks.title: Author the two histories, consent and action-led recollection
tasks.deliverable: Structured fiction for Iona, truthful legacy continuity, balanced private/public routes and a nonjudgmental Mara ending.
acceptance_criteria: Tie narration to accepted actions and concrete objects, with a readable transcript and no mandatory audio or animation.
Give privacy and public recognition equal warmth. New public sharing approves a dedication, not silent disclosure of the private letter.
Acknowledge an earlier peek on both routes. Preserve the fact that a legacy v1 archive choice published the letter.
Let writers replace cast names, pronouns, descriptions and portraits through pack content; keep those choices out of the shared engine.
tasks.completion_note: Authoring and continuity checks are present; emotional effect remains a human question.

tasks.title: Build original frame, lightbox and persistent object art
tasks.deliverable: Reproducible Blender props and painted SVG layers for both stories, with state-driven Three.js and flat presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Show the notch, wedge, sheltered letter, dedication at the frame edge and neutral cloth on its peg as distinct physical states.
Give Mara a separate workbench/lightbox composition whose drawing layers visibly align; no central talking portrait is required.
Keep editable originals, exported assets and generation instructions separate. Use local assets and no paid-generation dependency.
Cap DPR at 1.5 and remain below 100,000 active triangles; keep human appeal and physical-phone performance explicitly unverified.
tasks.completion_note: Nine automated renderer/art checks passed. This does not establish art appeal or physical-device FPS.

tasks.title: Provide equivalent pointer, keyboard and static interactions
tasks.deliverable: Shared inspect, choose, place and adjust controls with accessible text, focus behavior and optional 3D motion.
acceptance_criteria: Every drag has select-then-tap and keyboard equivalents; sketch adjustment supports a slider and step controls.
Treat camera movement as preview only, clamp tilt to ±12 degrees, and let explicit view controls select discoverable evidence.
Honor OS and manual reduced motion. Keep a complete flat mode for WebGL, asset and context failures without resetting progress.
Support cancellation and repeated input without losing an object. Keep real screen-reader and physical-phone checks on KF-23.
tasks.completion_note: Controls and failure paths implemented; integrated browser evidence is finalized by KF-10.

tasks.title: Implement per-story saves and explicit recovery
tasks.deliverable: Versioned local semantic checkpoints isolated by story and study profile, with legacy import and preserved incompatible saves.
acceptance_criteria: Store choices, recollection checkpoints and placement; do not store camera pixels, animation coordinates or transient inspection state.
Import keepers-frame:v1 only into Iona remembered, preserving actual archive disclosure and prior peek history.
Leave malformed or future records untouched until explicit recovery/reset. Blocked storage keeps the current session playable with an honest notice.
Forget only the active story/profile; prevent forgotten legacy memory from silently reappearing. Dispose sessions so stale callbacks cannot save into another story.
tasks.completion_note: Versioning, isolation, blocked storage and explicit recovery scenarios are implemented and covered by unit tests.

tasks.title: Complete Iona’s playable remembered-action story
tasks.deliverable: A full Iona story with the original rescue, action-led recollection, two legitimate choices and persistent return objects.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the approved rescue and complete the recollection before the new choice.
Offer only the correct placement for the saved choice/profile, and display it on later visits.
Cover private/archive × peek/no peek, neutral control, repeats, checkpoint reload and truthful legacy migration.
Keep optional legacy access to the new recollection without forcing a new emergency or overwriting the previous ending.
tasks.completion_note: Implemented on the game branch; human causality and enjoyment remain pending.

tasks.title: Integrate the story collection, art and shared controls
tasks.deliverable: A browser collection that loads either story lazily and supports story switching, resumption and flat fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Load story packs through one validated contract; keep story-name conditionals out of shared input and renderer behavior.
Render the same semantic state in 3D and flat modes. Dispose listeners, capture, pending loads and GPU resources on switching.
Keep failed story loading recoverable from the collection; guard late async results from restoring a previous scene.
Expose the neutral study profile explicitly and isolate it from remembered progress; do not silently randomize conditions.
tasks.completion_note: Both stories are playable; final frozen-build browser coverage remains KF-10.

tasks.title: Finish frozen-build journeys and verification provenance
tasks.deliverable: A dated functional/visual record for the exact candidate, including browser failures, edge cases and nested-path delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Exercise both Iona choices and peek histories, natural wrong signals, recollection reload, repeated/cancelled placement, neutral isolation and actual leave/reload behavior.
Complete Mara through visible controls in varied inspection orders; test alignment limits and ungraded ending interpretation.
Record desktop, touch emulation, keyboard, reduced motion, forced flat, missing assets, context loss, future/corrupt saves and blocked storage; collect errors in every context.
Retain historical 8-rule/13-observation evidence separately. Pin new run date, source SHA, build hash and screenshots; distinguish automated checks from physical phones and human screen-reader use.
tasks.completion_note: 51 unit tests and 16 full browser scenarios passed on the exact 0.1.2 build; authored labels checked. Prior 10 input/lifecycle and 9 renderer checks remain supporting evidence for unchanged logic/art. No human or physical-device pass.

tasks.title: Prepare recruitment and independent per-story human protocols
tasks.deliverable: Recruitment, consent, facilitation, observation and device/recall documents with empty human records.
acceptance_criteria: Target 18 fresh people: six Iona remembered, six Iona neutral and six Mara; require at least the two distinct six-person shipping-story cohorts for release.
Preregister the first six ordered session IDs per required story on the exact frozen build; include failure and abandonment without replacement.
Hold Iona first rescue/recollection constant; label scheduled same-session return as prompted exposure. Without neutral participants, make no comparative claim.
Require independent human review across all observers and participants. Preparation does not send invitations, invent participants or mark any gate passed.
tasks.completion_note: Study preparation is complete; actual recruitment and every participant result remain unfilled.

tasks.title: Run the two required story cohorts and optional neutral comparison
tasks.deliverable: Real, consented observations for Iona remembered and Mara, with a separate optional Iona neutral cohort.
acceptance_criteria: Use fresh, distinct participants across cohorts and the same exact master candidate; agent gameplay and synthetic tests contribute zero participant rows.
Record the assigned story/profile, build hash, device, prior exposure, assistance, completion, explanation and permitted direct quotes.
Keep all six predeclared attempts for each required cohort. Report actual denominators, failures, exits and missing data.
Keep neutral comparison descriptive; if unavailable, report a single-condition Iona pilot. Do not claim retention or preference from same-session return.
tasks.completion_note: Zero real participant sessions recorded; willing human participants are not yet arranged.

tasks.title: Optionally collect predeclared 48–72-hour prompted recall
tasks.deliverable: A consented later-session record with elapsed time, invitation history and attrition.
acceptance_criteria: Select this follow-up before testing, with consent and a human facilitator; this implementation sends no outreach.
Distinguish spontaneous revisit from a prompted follow-up and immediate restart. Report no-shows rather than inventing outcomes.
Ask about the specific action and persistent arrangement without teaching the explanation.
Call the result prompted recall, not retention; leave it unknown if the follow-up does not occur.
tasks.completion_note: Optional human follow-up, not a release substitute or automatic schedule.

tasks.title: Coordinate disjoint ownership and evidence-bearing handoffs
tasks.deliverable: A recorded story/runtime/art/UI/research/release contract and source checkpoints on the game branch.
acceptance_criteria: Assign separate file ownership to story, runtime, art/rendering, research and release agents; keep one UI/integration owner.
Record shared interfaces before parallel edits and preserve source/art/test handoffs with commands, evidence and remaining limits.
Keep source work on the Vivid branch, policy changes separate from promotion and versioned candidates on master.
Distinguish actual coding-agent assignments from unconfirmed human staffing; preserve historical records and remote recovery checkpoints.
tasks.completion_note: Agent ownership and implementation checkpoint recorded; source links are pinned to 0c72da9.

tasks.title: Freeze the portable 0.1.2 browser pilot package
tasks.deliverable: A local-asset candidate build, shipping-story catalog, honest entry copy and exact-build facilitator instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Bundle dependencies and selected story assets with relative paths; verify nested deployment and record the final source/build identity.
State authored interaction, local-only memory, reset/recovery and storage limitations. Duration labels remain authored estimates until real timing data exists.
Include Iona and Mara in a versioned shipping-story catalog inside the hashed build; do not ship the recast fixture as a third story.
Serve the exact master artifact locally or on a trusted LAN for human review. Do not imply master has a Pages URL or that portal publication is complete.
tasks.completion_note: Frozen 0.1.2 contains 15 files/1,401,263 bytes, dependency notices and pack-owned scene labels. Exact served files match master packet; no human approval.

tasks.owner_role: Product/design lead with research and QA
tasks.title: Decide advance, revise or stop from real observations
tasks.deliverable: A decision linking each story’s human results, contrary cases, competitor journeys and next bounded change.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluate each story independently against its predeclared criterion; one passing story cannot compensate for another failing shipping story.
If Iona’s picture is remembered but choice-to-action causality is not, revise or stop that hypothesis. Do not claim memory wins without the neutral comparison.
For Mara, evaluate unaided completion and action-to-visible-consequence explanation without grading emotional interpretation.
Keep competitor coverage, automated quality, physical-device results and human evidence separate. New stories or services need their own scoped decision.
tasks.completion_note: Conditional on actual observations; implementation approval does not settle product effectiveness.

tasks.title: Stage the complete two-story 0.1.2 candidate on master
tasks.deliverable: An immutable release-candidates/keepers-frame/0.1.2 packet with both stories, build inventory, notes and pending human evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Record exact implementation SHA, artifact version, build file hashes and shipping-story catalog; include only intended portable files.
Run staging validation with blank human fields still pending. Confirm every inventoried build file is tracked.
Push master without force and record its full remote SHA; preserve recoverable history and do not merge the whole game branch into master.
Keep full readiness failing until valid human reports and independent review cover both stories on the same frozen build.
tasks.completion_note: Candidate 0.1.2 staged on master at f9488e5079d1d193caef560d1fe72936add6cba3; 0.1.0 and 0.1.1 remain byte-identical to their earlier packets. Pending per-story reports contain no human sessions.

tasks.title: Review both stories against the exact-build human release gate
tasks.deliverable: A schema-v2 report with one required report per shipped story and an independent build-specific human approval.
acceptance_criteria: Iona: at least 4/6 participants each both complete unaided and explain choice-to-return causality; at most 1/6 expects unrestricted AI.
Mara: at least 4/6 each both complete unaided and explain an action-to-visible-consequence connection. Do not score the emotional interpretation as correct or wrong.
Use distinct first-six cohorts, all attempts, the same exact build hash and zero open critical bugs. A missing story report fails the whole candidate.

An independent real human reviews raw observations and plays the exact build; physical input/accessibility checks remain required. Blank reports, automation and fictional personas never satisfy approval.
tasks.completion_note: No participant reports or human approval are available.

tasks.title: Promote only a human-approved anthology release to main
tasks.deliverable: A reviewed official package, immutable registry entry, GitHub release/version notes and a verified deployed URL.
acceptance_criteria: First merge the separately reviewed release-policy change; then copy only an approved master packet into the canonical releases path.
Require both story reports and human approval on the exact artifact; preserve prior releases and verify master ancestry and byte identity.
Use a promotion PR and required human/code-owner review. A game-source push, staging pass or policy PR is not official approval.
After approved promotion, verify tag, GitHub Release notes, registry links and actual Pages delivery. Main currently has no official releases; Pages availability is unverified.
tasks.completion_note: Conditional on human gates and separate policy review; no release tag or official play URL is claimed.

tasks.title: Make stories and protagonists replaceable through packs
tasks.deliverable: A lazy catalog and pure pack contract for content, cast, scene presentation, state, saves and accessible actions.
acceptance_criteria: Expose createState, reduce, getViewModel, serialize and migrate with manifest/content revision separate from save schema.
Validate IDs, local assets, cast references and interaction capabilities before build; preserve the gallery on load failure.
Prove replacement with a development-only recast fixture and an independently structured second story; no story-name branching in shared engine behavior.
tasks.completion_note: Lazy pure story packs, independent saves, validated cast replacement and optional authored scene captions/accessible labels are implemented. A theatre fixture checks another setting through save restoration.

tasks.title: Deliver Mara’s object-led mystery
tasks.deliverable: The Unfinished Postcard: nonlinear inspection, sketch alignment and a workshop reveal with ungraded interpretation.
acceptance_criteria: Allow timetable, paint-marked postcard and drawings in any inspection order.
Require evidence and valid alignment before revealing the workshop; slider, steps and keyboard share reducer rules.
Use a workbench rather than a required speaking portrait, rescue loop or return-choice structure; complete the story without editing the shared runtime.
tasks.completion_note: Second playable story implemented; human interpretation and completion remain untested.

tasks.title: Review the multi-story release policy separately
tasks.deliverable: A separately reviewed release-gate change binding one report per shipping story to the same catalog and build hash.
acceptance_criteria: Require exactly the catalog’s shipped stories, fixed reviewed threshold profiles, distinct cohorts and independent approval across all participants and observers.
Reject missing/extra story reports, identity/hash mismatches and legacy-schema bypass for new multi-story candidates; preserve older release readability and immutability.
Keep tooling review separate from game promotion and retain the empty official registry until actual human evidence passes.
tasks.completion_note: Policy PR #1 is open for separate independent code-owner review; it has not been merged and does not approve any game release.

tasks.title: Measure physical-device performance and accessibility
tasks.deliverable: A real-device record covering mobile input, frame pacing, reading, motion comfort and screen-reader use.
acceptance_criteria: Measure the exact master artifact on physical phone hardware, recording device, browser, settings, cold load and observed frame pacing; target 30 FPS.
Manually complete both stories with touch and assess keyboard/focus, text readability and a real screen reader; record assistance and every blocker.
Keep ≤8 MiB cold-load, ≤100,000 active triangles and DPR ≤1.5 checks separate from actual phone performance. Headless emulation is not a physical pass.
tasks.completion_note: No physical-phone or human screen-reader measurements are available.

tasks.title: Reconcile the October 20 evidence delta and the B4 substitution
tasks.deliverable: A versioned B1–B6 ledger, source-conflict note and explicit roster decision for Rogue Fable IV.
acceptance_criteria: Record Detective’s recovered October 6 SOLVED report and reload restart separately from October 12–13 partial retries; do not describe the in-game replay control as verified.
Record Seedship v1.4.0 as one terminal colony run with 9 planets and score 2,873; record no actual second run, share action or banked session screenshots.

Preserve the original roster count of 3/6 gameplay titles across three families. If Rogue Fable IV is adopted, record the B4 replacement, v0.26 browser build, precise title URL/provenance gap, tactical relevance and unanswered party-dice allocation question; only then label the adjusted count 4/6 across four families.
Use A Dark Room’s raw trading-post/compass endpoint; explicitly flag the package README’s contradictory “no stranger” summary. Do not count duplicated records/images as new sessions.

Label Slice & Dice access findings and archived Steam trailer as October 20 market evidence, not gameplay; scope the no-browser finding to the checked creator listings and keep the free native demo distinct from the paid full game.

tasks.title: Plan the remaining exploration and tactics comparisons
tasks.deliverable: An access-conditional study plan and claim ledger for Outer Wilds, Into the Breach and any explicitly selected replacement.
acceptance_criteria: List exact edition, legal access/device needs, available input/audio, prior exposure, complete activity boundary and remaining question for each study; authorize no purchases, installs or play through this card.

Preserve Outer Wilds’ self-directed expedition question and Into the Breach’s visible-intent/sacrifice question. A proposed reserve must name the question it leaves unanswered and recalculate distinct titles and family limits.
For future sessions, capture at least one prediction before an action, a natural mistake/recovery if encountered, exact terminal or stopping state, and actual retry separately from an invitation.

Attach the full coverage gate to final competitive claims: six distinct titles, at least four families, at least two outside narrative/deduction, no more than two per family, and two deep comparisons from different families with complete bounded units. Bounded design specification may proceed with disclosed gaps after the experiment is settled; source-only titles never satisfy firsthand coverage.
Keep agent interpretations, critic claims, storefront facts, screenshots and human accounts in separate evidence fields.

tasks.title: Settle the two-loop causal experiment before implementation
tasks.deliverable: A chosen concept, state/choice table, scope boundary and signed-off comparison protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Choose between the three bounded stories above; retain one Bell Square Dawn→Noon event, Mina and Brann, one observed clue, one intervention and one changed outcome.
Specify how an actually witnessed blockage produces a provenance-bearing clue, how that clue permits the next-loop intervention, and how ordinary versus borrowed visits change the opportunity cost.
Cover correct/wrong/blank forecasts, absent witness, late arrival, no Momentum, missed intervention, Fracture 4, revisit, restart and mode switching; preserve understandable failure and recovery.
Use current Contrast as the main comparison and keep an immutable Original reference. Do not attribute Original’s skip/journal/batching differences to the new experiment.
Record the unresolved research/human questions and a keep/revise/defer criterion. The plan must be explicitly settled before any game source, art asset or gameplay implementation starts.

tasks.title: Make Bell Square’s Dawn→Noon event occur in the world
tasks.deliverable: One bounded event transition and a documented clue-provenance schema, after TB-03 is settled.
acceptance_criteria: Event state changes at the selected ordinary phase boundary regardless of forecast answer; forecast text, encounter and map agree about what happened.
Separate scheduled/revealed information from personally observed evidence. Grant the clue only through the specified witnessed scene, with source event, loop and phase recorded.
A player elsewhere can discover the changed Square state later without receiving retroactive eyewitness credit or a falsely worded “Witnessed” message.
Do not build a general NPC schedule simulator, extra district, meter or item-key framework; leave other authored loops readable and the existing ending reachable.

tasks.title: Make one learned intervention change Mina’s outcome
tasks.deliverable: One clue-gated route preparation action and two visible outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Without the witnessed clue, present an honest unavailable-action explanation without revealing the answer. With the clue, expose one meaningful intervention before Noon; no extra carried-token key is required.

A regular visit can perform the intervention at its normal phase cost. A valid borrowed visit fits it beside a normal expedition action; the extra action creates an opportunity the player can explain.
Spend exactly 1 Momentum atomically on commitment, once per loop after loop one and on a previously visited route; reservation and cancellation spend nothing.
A borrowed action holds phase and forecast only while Fracture remains below 4. Fracture 4 still forces midnight; the next real boundary resolves a locked forecast and rewards it at most once.
Show the missed opportunity and successful destination as specific Mina outcomes, with a recoverable next plan; do not grade the player’s morality.

tasks.title: Write the clue, intervention and aftermath as a checkable story
tasks.deliverable: A compact script sheet for two Square states, one action, two outcomes and one receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Settle one concrete cause using existing flower/crate/market/alley motifs: what blocks Mina, what the player can observe, why preparation changes it and where Mina ends up.
Distinguish observation, prediction, inference and outcome in wording. A correct guess alone never becomes an eyewitness claim.
Write ordinary, informed, absent-clue, late and missed-opportunity variants; each references the same cause without adding a second puzzle.
Make Brann and Mina’s responses specific to the action. The receipt says what the player did and what changed, without congratulating an unsupported deduction.
Preserve the wider game’s tone and avoid new endings, relationship meters, lore branches or long explanatory monologues.

tasks.title: Put the usable clue and its cost beside the next decision
tasks.deliverable: A focused action panel and short evidence receipt within the existing journal.
acceptance_criteria: Display clue provenance and the pending intervention’s Momentum/Fracture cost near the relevant action; the player should not need to cross-reference the entire people×phase table.
Label schedule knowledge, observed fact and untested theory differently in text, not only by color; keep the clue available across midnight and clear it on restart.
At the outcome, show a short observation → action → changed destination receipt; do not reveal an unearned solution through a global highlight.
Keep the existing Place/Theory journal available while limiting the new feature to one receipt and one local cue; no new top-level dashboard or meter.

tasks.title: Create a small scene kit that makes the route change visible
tasks.deliverable: Two Bell Square scene states and one changed-outcome inset, with annotated composition references.
acceptance_criteria: Retain the canon map and repeat the same Mina silhouette, crate, redflower and alley landmarks so the later image can be compared with the earlier one.
Stage the blocking crowd and alternate destination legibly at desktop, 390px portrait and compact iframe sizes without a full-town repaint or portrait roster.
Labels and shape/location cues communicate the change in grayscale and with motion disabled; optional bell/route audio has mute and equivalent text.
Provide before/after annotations identifying which visible detail teaches the clue and which confirms consequence. Do not use decorative animation as evidence that the action mattered.

tasks.title: Keep the full decision path reachable and understandable
tasks.deliverable: Keyboard, touch-layout, focus and reduced-motion acceptance evidence for both outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Complete witness → clue → intervention → outcome using keyboard alone; focus remains visible, follows modal transitions and returns to the triggering action.
Check label associations, state announcements, readable contrast/text, reduced motion and non-color cues; disabled actions state their reason without requiring hover.
Check 390×844 portrait and 821×462 iframe layouts, zoom and long-page scroll recovery. State clearly when these are emulated viewports rather than real device observations.
Run a real touch-device/Safari check only when the device is available; record unavailable coverage and never turn desktop screenshots into a mobile usability claim.
A newly accessible action may not bypass a clue requirement, spend Momentum twice or allow a second borrow.

tasks.title: Preserve restart, loop and mode boundaries
tasks.deliverable: A state ownership/reset table and a small implementation patch with one engine integrator.
acceptance_criteria: Define which event, clue and outcome fields persist across midnight, reset on a new run, and remain isolated between Original and Contrast.
Prevent double resolution from repeated Continue input or revisits; preserve pending-action guards, new-scene retention, cancel semantics and once-only forecast reward.
Retain the existing no-save-on-reload behavior unless separately chosen later; label this limitation in the pilot and distribution notes.
One systems owner integrates engine.js; narrative and art contributors work through agreed data/asset seams, not simultaneous changes to the compressed engine.
Record base/new commit, build output hash, rollback reference and touched paths. Do not change unrelated districts or repair Original within this experiment.

tasks.title: Verify the cause-and-effect slice and the complete existing path
tasks.deliverable: A scenario matrix, exact build identifiers and visible-control traces/screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Run the existing build, three echo-time tests, 17 static checks and applicable smoke/journey suites against the new isolated build; historical passing results alone are insufficient.
Cover witnessed/unwitnessed clue, correct/wrong/blank forecast, ordinary/borrowed intervention, no Momentum, cancellation, revisit, late/missed opportunity and both Mina outcomes.
Cover second-borrow rejection, atomic spend, locked phase/forecast, reward exactly once, Fracture reaching 4, restart, mode switching and retention of unseen new scenes.
Re-run the existing full ending and restart through visible controls. Publish exact counts and failures, console errors and artifact links rather than a bare “works”.
Block the human pilot on repeatable wrong-state, duplicate-reward or inaccessible-action failures; repair and rerun only the affected checks plus justified regression coverage.

tasks.owner_role: Human playtest owner + Bell design lead
tasks.title: Prepare a six-person formative comparison without teaching the solution
tasks.deliverable: A consent/observation template, counterbalanced build order and predeclared decision sheet.
acceptance_criteria: Plan six new participants, three per first-build order: current Contrast then candidate, or candidate then current Contrast. Record genre familiarity, device, prior exposure and any help.
Capture the player’s causal explanation and prediction before the result; prompt neutrally. Treat second-build responses as affected by learning and emphasize first-exposure evidence.

Record help requests, wrong forecasts, rereading, missed-opportunity reaction, Fracture explanation and optional retry/leave choice. Elicit outcome recall after a two-minute neutral break following each run, before the next build or final debrief; this is short-delay recall, not next-day retention.

Predeclare the thresholds below and record the exact denominator. Report candidate-build results separately for the two first-build orders (three each), alongside the six-person total; keep current-Contrast results separate. Do not turn six sessions into a statistical superiority, retention or market-demand claim.
Recruitment and consent belong to the human owner when separately arranged. No invitations or external messages are sent by preparing this plan.

tasks.owner_role: Human playtest owner + Bell design lead
tasks.title: Observe six real players and decide keep, revise or defer
tasks.deliverable: Consented raw observations, build-order log and an evidence-linked design decision.
acceptance_criteria: Require six actual new participants and TB-11’s passing pilot gate; an agent run or roleplay supplies zero participant rows.
At least four of six explain the witnessed cause and predict the intervention consequence before receiving it.

At least four of six use the earned action without coaching and explain that Fracture can still end the day; at least three name Mina’s specific changed outcome after the predeclared two-minute break, rather than only extra Momentum.
Record zero repeatable wrong-state, duplicate-reward or inaccessible-action failures. Keep all misses/help requests and build-order effects visible.

If success comes from memorized answers or highlighting without causal explanation, revise the slice; if the outcome is remembered only as a meter, revise the payoff. Incomplete recruitment leaves the decision pending, not passed.
Separate verbatim participant words, observed behavior and interpretation; optional retry is immediate behavior, not delayed return or retention.

tasks.title: Prepare an honest browser pilot package
tasks.deliverable: A local preview manifest, entry copy and itch.io/CrazyGames readiness checklist with dated sources.
acceptance_criteria: State the intended context as an itch.io browser release/pilot; treat CrazyGames as a separate acquisition context whose current technical requirements still need authorized verification.
Package the tested portable build with commit/hash, direct launch instructions, viewport/input limitations, no-save-on-reload disclosure and one clear route into the selected comparison build.
Measure actual loading/entry behavior when implementation exists; do not reuse the 4–8 minute UI promise as a measured human duration.
Use copy about the concrete learned-action payoff; make no uniqueness, preference, retention or market-conversion claim from competitor notes or six formative sessions.
Preparing the package does not publish, upload to a portal, add accounts, purchase services or install analytics. Release is a later scoped decision.

tasks.title: Keep the plan, dependencies and evidence reviewable
tasks.deliverable: A dashboard-ready task export and phase decision log with artifact links.
acceptance_criteria: Keep all cards proposed/conditional/blocked_human until their stated prerequisites are met and work is actually assigned; owner roles are not accepted assignments.
Record TB-03’s settled design before implementation begins. Separate design readiness, QA readiness, human-evidence readiness and final competitive-claim readiness.
For each completed future card, attach the source/build commit, acceptance evidence and open limits; never mark the plan itself as a completed game feature.
Reconcile the new Bell evidence addendum with the older audit without rewriting historical claims as though the recovered records had always been present.
Defer general schedule simulation, new districts/endings, bond/item frameworks, save/accounts, procedural cases, co-op, generalized art overhaul, paid distribution and analytics backend.

tasks.title: Stage one immutable candidate on master
tasks.deliverable: A versioned release-candidates/thirteenth-bell/<version>/ package on master, built from the owning game branch.
acceptance_criteria: Record the exact source SHA, version, player-facing notes, build inventory and hash; include a portable build/index.html and only intended files.
Use the release-candidate template and staging validator. Preserve the predeclared human-session protocol before recruiting; staging may contain pending evidence and is not an official release.
Keep the previous candidate and source branch recoverable, push master without force, and verify its remote SHA. Do not merge the whole game branch into master or main.

tasks.title: Review the exact candidate against the human release gate
tasks.deliverable: A complete human-playtest.json and linked anonymized records for the exact packaged build, with a recorded approve/revise/stop decision.
acceptance_criteria: Six predeclared individual players: at least 4/6 each explain cause and predict consequence; at least 4/6 each use the earned action uncoached and explain Fracture; at least 3/6 recall a specific Mina outcome after a neutral break of at least 120 seconds. Keep the counterbalanced first-build groups of three visible in the design analysis.

Include every one of the six predeclared sessions, distinct pseudonymous participant IDs, raw observations and assistance. An incomplete, abandoned or assisted attempt cannot be silently replaced or counted as unaided success.

Zero unresolved critical bugs; manually check actual browser entry, core journey, failure/retry, keyboard, and one physical mobile/touch device. Record measured duration and issues rather than inferring results from automated checks.

An independent human reviewer inspects the evidence and signs the build-specific approval. Existing pilot sessions may be reused only if the protocol was predeclared, participants and required outcomes are recorded, and the artifact hash matches exactly; changed builds need revalidation.
Run full candidate validation. A failed gate stays on master; agent sessions and synthetic test fixtures cannot satisfy human evidence.

tasks.title: Promote only the approved game version to main
tasks.deliverable: A reviewed official release package, registry entry, GitHub version and release-note links, plus a verified playable Pages URL.
acceptance_criteria: Copy only the approved candidate package into releases/<game>/<version>/ on main. Pin its immutable ancestor commit on master; preserve all previous official versions and registry entries.
Open a main promotion PR with human approval and gate results. Required owner review and release-gate must pass; do not auto-merge or include unrelated candidates.

After the human-approved merge, verify automated GitHub release publication, tag target, notes, registry links and the deployed Pages build. A push or draft link alone is not a verified official delivery.
If publication fails, preserve the approved artifact, report the actual failure and rerun only the failed publication step. Never rewrite a released version; publish corrections under a new version.
